mapper.update: UPDATE code_table SET thumb_x = #{thumbX}, thumb_y = #{thumbY}, index_x = #{indexX}, index_y = #{indexY}, middle_x = #{middleX}, middle_y = #{middleY}, ring_x = #{ringX}, ring_y = #{ringY}, pinky_x = #{pinkyX}, pinky_y = #{pinkyY}, thumb_open = #{thumbOpen}, mp3_path = #{mp3Path}, code_name = #{codeName} WHERE code_id = #{codeId};
mapper.select:

SELECT code_id AS codeId, thumb_x AS thumbX, thumb_y AS thumbY, index_x AS indexX, index_y AS indexY, middle_x AS middleX, middle_y AS middleY, ring_x AS ringX, ring_y AS ringY, pinky_x AS pinkyX, pinky_y AS pinkyY, thumb_open AS thumbOpen, mp3_path AS mp3Path, code_name AS codeName, created_at AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAtStr FROM code_table
AND code_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')
ORDER BY code_name ASC
ORDER BY code_name DESC
